tagline: Themed restaurant web experience featuring animations, interactive menus, and immersive UI design.

details.overview: GhoulEats is a Halloween-themed restaurant web application built with React and Framer Motion. The project focuses on creating an engaging user experience through interactive animations, themed storytelling, responsive layouts, and reusable component architecture.
engineering_challenges: Creating smooth animations without affecting performance
Building reusable UI components across multiple pages
Designing a consistent visual theme throughout the application
Implementing dynamic menu filtering with responsive interactions
key_features: Framer Motion animations for page transitions and interactions
Multi-page navigation with themed user experience
Responsive design across desktop and mobile devices
what_i_learned: Building immersive user experiences with modern frontend tools
Using Framer Motion to create smooth and engaging interactions
Balancing creative design with usability and performance
